## 维护者速读

- 给 ADR-0046 §6.7 补一条只增不改的注记：书的可见范围多了一种写法「持有某项系统权限的人」，按你 11-24 选的方案 A 落地，代码已在 #37591 合并。
- 注记写明三件事：新写法怎么判定（看调用者自己的系统权限，缺失即拒）、为什么不能只写权限集名（setup.access 由多个权限集授予）、以及一条编写规则（受限的书要按名字认领页面，不能用 `include: '*'`）。
- 只是文档，不改任何行为；出错的最坏情况是 ADR 描述不准，撤回即可。
- 可能需要你：改的是 `docs/adr/**`，若座位判为 Tier H，需你批准后才能合并。

## What changes

One add-only amendment block in `docs/adr/0046-package-docs-as-metadata.md` §6.7, placed right after the existing `framework#3963` amendment (+32 / −0; no existing line touched, the Status line included, so the generated ADR index is unchanged). It records:

- `book.audience` gains a fourth form, `{ systemPermission: 'TOKEN' }` (strict): a signed-in caller whose own `systemPermissions` holds the capability, through any permission set — the list an app's `requiredPermissions` is judged on. Anonymous, or an absent / non-list list, is denied (fail closed, ADR-0049). The set form and the capability form read two lists and never satisfy each other. On the MCP docs tools, a delegated OAuth grant is judged on the delegating person's own capabilities (ADR-0090 D10). The §6.7 union rule is unchanged.
- Why: `{ permissionSet }` names one set, and `setup.access` comes with several. Ruling of record 7122770897 (「A 按系统权限判定」); first consumers `setup_manual` / `studio_manual`.
- One authoring rule: a gated book claims its pages by name, never `include: '*'` — an unstamped stored doc is in every package scope (contract review S1 on #37591, 7196156631).

Drafted at the ADR tier the surface mandates, then checked sentence by sentence against the merged code (`packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts`, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-package-docs.ts`, the two manual files).
